box.highlights: Ward Melville 34, Sachem East 12: Andrew Belli ran for two touchdowns and threw for one in Suffolk I. His 1-yard run in the first quarter broke a scoreless tie and his 4-yarder in the second quarter gave the Patriots a 20-6 lead. He threw a nine-yard touchdown pass in the third quarter. Nick Gaffney ran for two touchdown, a 2-yarder in the first quarter and a 19-yarder in the second.

Ward Melville 41, Commack 21: Nick Gaffney rushed for 151 yards on 24 carries and two touchdowns in Suffolk I. Brody Morgan had an interception in the fourth quarter and three touchback kickoffs for Ward Melville (2-1). Morgan also had two 25-yard kick returns and seven catches for 87 yards. Lorenzo Velez made six catches for 152 yards and two touchdowns. Andrew Belli completed 17 of 29 passes for 310 yards for four touchdowns and an interception, and added 36 yards rushing. Jeremy Weiss threw two touchdown passes in the second half for Commack (1-2).

Ward Melville 60, Sachem North 26: Andrew Belli scored five total touchdowns, with three coming through the air and two coming on the ground to lead Ward Melville (3-1) in Suffolk I. Nick Gaffney caught a 25-yard touchdown in the second quarter and broke off a 47-yard rushing score in the third quarter. Brody Morgan had a 65-yard touchdown reception to open the scoring and Max Behar had a 43-yard interception return touchdown. Anthony Vino threw two touchdowns and had a rushing touchdown.

Ward Melville 48, Riverhead 0: Andrew Belli completed 3-of-5 passes for 68 yards and two touchdowns and added 47 rushing yards and a touchdown on four carries for Ward Melville in Suffolk I. Nick Gaffney had 14 carries for 127 yards and a touchdown and Griffin Kramer added 105 rushing yards on 14 carries. Brody Morgan returned a punt 68 yards for a touchdown and went 6-for-7 on PAT attempts. Ward Melville totaled 375 yards rushing and averaged 8.7 yards per carry.

Floyd 38, Ward Melville 0: LaDuke Harris threw an 18-yard touchdown to Gio Alvarez and rushed for 105 yards anda touchdown to lead Floyd (6-0) in Suffolk I. Caden Lesiewicz logged an interception on defense, one catch for 55 yards and 51 rushing yards on offense. Lesiewicz also converted a 23 yard FG. Dylan Harris rushed for 52 yards and two touchdowns on 11 carries. Harris also added nine tackles on defense. Javon Delaney had a 40-yard interception return touchdown.

Ward Melville 42, Whitman 0: Andrew Belli threw for two touchdowns to lead Ward Melville (5-2) in Suffolk I. Nick Gaffney had two touchdowns in the second half on runs of one yard and eight yards. Ethan Burgos scored a 19-yard rushing touchdown and threw a 30-yard touchdown to Hunter Morgan in the third quarter. Mike Riccardi made seven tackles and Griffin Kramer batted away six passes and made three tackles.

Patchogue-Medford 28, Ward Melville 27: Nick Elliott had three catches for 53 yards, including a game-winning 34-yard touchdown reception with 1:59 remaining for Patchogue-Medford (4-4) in Suffolk I. Third-string quarterback Jayden Isselbacher threw for 170 yards and two touchdowns and rushed for 67 yards and two touchdowns. C.J. Forgione had six catches for 57 yards and five solo tackles. Alex Hofmann had eight tackles and also recovered a fumble forced by Max Adams and Joe Kelly on Ward Melville's last drive. Justin Marcia-Joachim had three receptions for 52 yards and a touchdown.

Ward Melville 38, Whitman 7: Nick Gaffney rushed for two touchdowns to help No. 4 Ward Melville defeat No. 5 Whitman in the first round of the Suffolk I playoffs. His first touchdown was from 51 yards and the second from 28. Ward Melville scored 38 unanswered points to start the game, all in the first half, but did not score after halftime. Andrew Belli threw three touchdowns in the win, including a 60-yard pass to Jackson Weber. Cameron Carlson scored Whitman's only touchdown in the third quarter on a 7-yard run.
No. 4 Ward Melville defeats No. 1 Floyd in the Suffolk I semifinals.
